about: Guidance for registering a trademark in the UAE through the Ministry of Economy.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP (Abu Dhabi IP) guidance page on the checked date. AD.iP gives guidance and the filing is made with the Ministry of Economy, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The mark must be in use in trade and distinctive, and not easily confused with a mark for similar goods or services
documents: Individual UAE-based owner: no licence needed
Company or institution: a commercial licence
Filing through an agent: a legal power of attorney
Foreign owner: must file through a registration agent with a notarised power of attorney
fees: Fees are paid after submission; amounts are not stated on the page
timing: Steps run from submission to fee payment, examination and then registration; no time is stated
channels: Ministry of Economy online trademark portal
AD.iP lists IP service providers for help
